title: APO Lamb Medallions with Mint-Almond Gravy
description: Trimmed lamb loin medallions are sliced thinly and coated in a mint gravy thickened with a slurry and smooth almond paste.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: lean boneless lamb loin
ingredients.note: Remove exterior fat and silver skin before weighing; cut medallions 3/4 inch thick.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.note: Tear leaves in half, leaving pieces large enough to strain.

ingredients.name: smooth unsalted blanched almond paste
ingredients.note: Use pure almonds, fully ground and unsweetened.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 155°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 145°F.

steps.title: Probe the loin
steps.text: Set {lamb} in a single layer, unbagged, in the pan on the middle rack. Insert the probe horizontally into the thickest center. Begin cooking immediately and set a separate 20-minute reminder for the first temperature check; respond sooner if the probe signals.

steps.title: Steep the mint
steps.text: While the lamb cooks, bring {broth} and {coriander} to a simmer in the HexClad. Add {mint}, turn off the heat and cover for 4 minutes. Strain the broth back into the skillet.

steps.title: Blend in almond paste
steps.text: Whisk {almond} with a splash of the strained broth until smooth, then stir it back into the pan.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Brighten the gravy
steps.text: Stir {lemon} into the thick gravy off heat.

steps.title: Cook in steam
steps.text: Cook 25–50 minutes, checking at 20 minutes, until every center is at least 145°F.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Remove the pan and rest the medallions loosely covered in their juices for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Coat the lamb
steps.text: Slice the lamb thinly across the grain. Spoon mint gravy between the slices and around both portions.

notes: Make ahead: Trim and portion the loin a day ahead. Steep the fresh mint on the day of serving for a brighter flavor. Option A uses lemon and mint. For gentler Option B, omit the lemon and infuse with parsley instead of mint. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze lamb slices in gravy for up to 6 weeks. Stir the almond gravy smooth as it reheats. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth.
